attempt1: Propose the full past-due amount (or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much) on the last business day of this week, or of next week if today is that day, capped at the deadline.

prompts.founded_year: In what year was the company founded?

opening.text: Hello, this is Brightwell Commercial's digital assistant, and this call is recorded.

ask_again.text: Sorry, to be sure: am I speaking with {title} {last_name} at {company_name}?

condolence.text: I am sorry for your loss.

debt_intro.text: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.

first_ask.text: Can you make this payment today?

first_ask_multi.text: Can you pay all of these today?

promise_confirmation.text: You will receive an email confirming this promise.

ai.text: I am Brightwell Commercial's digital assistant.

scam.text: You can verify this call by phoning your relationship manager or the number on brightwell.example.

failed_id.text: I cannot continue; please contact your relationship manager.

paid_reply.text: Payments can take one business day to appear.

change_promise.text: A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in this call.

cannot_record.text: I could not record the promise.

no_info.text: I do not have that information.

hardship_sympathy.text: I am sorry to hear that.

hint_retry.text: That answer was not correct; please try again.

goodbye.text: Thank you for your time, goodbye.

extra_rules.statement: The product id format is not stated in the brief; use the product_id returned by get_account.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Use that id in every tool call about the product.

extra_rules.statement: Only yes, that's me, speaking or the customer's own name confirms identity; hello, go ahead, who is this do not. Ask once more; if still unclear close not_reached/unclear. Answer a customer question first, and the ask that follows is the second ask.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If it is still unclear after the second ask, close as `not_reached` / `unclear`.

extra_rules.statement: If someone else answers, do not say why you are calling, say nothing beyond the opening sentence, and ask when the customer can be reached.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not say why you are calling.

extra_rules.statement: If a callback time offered is outside the window, ask once for another; if also outside, do not schedule and close not_reached/no_callback.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask once for another time

extra_rules.statement: Nobody but the customer may answer security questions or be told about the account, even if they offer to pay.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Nobody but the customer may answer the security questions

extra_rules.statement: Send company number as eight digits with no spaces and founded year as four digits.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Send the eight digits with no spaces. Send four digits.

extra_rules.statement: After three wrong answers in total, do not state the debt; tell the customer to contact their relationship manager and close not_verified/failed.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Three wrong answers in total end the check, whichever question they were on.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer declines to answer, explain once that the questions protect the account; a second refusal or asking what the call is about a second time closes not_verified/declined. Asking what the call is about counts as declining.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining.

extra_rules.statement: State every late product, one sentence each, before asking for anything; name the product in words with past-due amount and days late.
extra_rules.brief_quote: State every late product, one sentence each, before asking for anything.

extra_rules.statement: Promise date must be today or later, a business day, not after the deadline. Weekend or holiday not after deadline: offer next business day. Date after deadline: say latest recordable date is the deadline and offer it; refusal of the deadline is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Vague date: ask once for the exact day; if none, propose the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask once for the exact day. If they still give none, propose the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Ask for the full past-due amount first; never ask how much the customer can pay. If full is too much offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue. Amount between floor and full is accepted; below floor say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once; refusal is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never ask "how much can you pay?". The agent proposes every amount.

extra_rules.statement: A date or amount proposed by the customer is never a refusal. A flat refusal or non-answer uses one persuasion attempt; a no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal. When attempts are used up, do not repeat a refused offer and close no_promise/refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A date or an amount the customer proposes is never a refusal.

extra_rules.statement: Illness, death in family or job loss: one short sympathy sentence, no persuasion attempt, offer support team transfer; accept leads to transfer support, decline to no_promise/hardship. If customer still names a date or amount, record the promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt

extra_rules.statement: Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any term not in the brief.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.

extra_rules.statement: Read product, amount and date back and ask for confirmation; call create_promise only after a clear yes. If the customer changes date or amount, recheck and read back again. One promise per product; recorded promises cannot be changed or cancelled.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Call `create_promise` only after a clear yes

extra_rules.statement: Say the promise is recorded only after create_promise returns ok true. If it fails retry once; if it fails again say you could not record it and close no_promise/service_error (with several products keep recorded ones and note the failed product service_error).
extra_rules.brief_quote: Say the promise is recorded only after `create_promise` returns `ok: true`.

extra_rules.statement: Already paid: say payments can take one business day to appear, take no promise, close paid (with notes reason paid per product).
extra_rules.brief_quote: "I already paid": say that payments can take one business day to appear

extra_rules.statement: Dispute, never had the product, or product closed/paid off in the past: do not argue, take no promise, close no_promise/dispute.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not argue and do not take a promise

extra_rules.statement: Request for new payment plan or lower instalments: do not describe a plan; transfer to restructuring and close transferred/restructuring.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not describe a plan

extra_rules.statement: Request for a human: ask once whether you can help first; if they insist transfer to relationship_manager and close transferred/human, before and after verification.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask once whether you can help first

extra_rules.statement: Scam question: say the call can be verified via relationship manager or the number on brightwell.example, and continue.
extra_rules.brief_quote: "Is this a scam?"

extra_rules.statement: A question not answerable from the tools: say you do not have that information; invent no figures, dates or reasons.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not invent figures, dates or reasons.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer says twice they do not want to talk, close no_promise/refused; before verification close not_verified/declined.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the customer says twice that they do not want to talk

extra_rules.statement: Several products: first ask whether all can be paid today; if not go product by product in get_account order without asking about today again, each starting at attempt 1, attempts counted per product. One date for everything after a product's deadline: record that product on its own deadline and say so in the read-back. Read all promises back together, one confirmation, then create_promise per product.
extra_rules.brief_quote: First ask whether the customer can pay all of them today.

extra_rules.statement: For each product ending without a promise call add_note with product_id and reason, also when only one product or no product gets a promise. Dispute or paid claim on one product does not end the call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: call `add_note` with `product_id` and a reason

extra_rules.statement: On any transfer add no notes. Promises recorded before a restructuring transfer stay; agreed but unrecorded promises are not recorded. A transfer after a recorded promise closes as the transfer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: On any transfer add no notes at all.

extra_rules.statement: Close with promise if at least one promise recorded (except on transfer); if none and all products noted paid, close paid; otherwise no_promise with reason of the first non-paid product in get_account order.
extra_rules.brief_quote: `promise` wins whenever at least one promise was recorded, except on a transfer.

extra_rules.statement: Exactly one close_call, as the last tool call, after thanking the customer and saying goodbye.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Every call ends with exactly one `close_call`

extra_rules.statement: All date rules use now from the call variables, not the real clock.
extra_rules.brief_quote: All date rules use this, never the real clock.

_source./bands/1/attempts: | 16 to 60 | late | the 5th business day after today | 2 |

_source./identity/max_wrong: Three wrong answers in total end the check
_source./callback/same_day: A callback is for today or the next business day

_source./lines/first_ask: Can you make this payment today?

_source./close_rule: Otherwise close as `no_promise` with the reason of the first product, in `get_account` order, whose note is not `paid`.
